description: Reviewable instruction slices for agents: onboarding, scheduled cloud roles, and lane playbooks aligned to the SDLC grid (file names A1–A12 remain for reference).

patterns.title: Adopt Ship (baseline)
patterns.summary: Primary onboarding playbook before any org-specific addendum.

patterns.title: Adopt Ship (reference org)
patterns.summary: Queue names, digest/retro, QA-first habits; apply after the baseline playbook.

patterns.title: Shared base
patterns.summary: Cross-role guardrails and tone for scheduled cloud agents.

patterns.title: Intake
patterns.summary: Role prompt for intake lane on the SDLC grid.

patterns.title: Clarification
patterns.summary: Structured follow-ups when requirements are incomplete.

patterns.title: BA / specification
patterns.summary: Specification and handoff quality before implementation picks.

patterns.title: Developer
patterns.summary: Implementation role: branch contract, PR shape, evidence.

patterns.title: QA architect
patterns.summary: Test strategy and automation hooks for delivery quality.

patterns.title: Tech architect
patterns.summary: Architecture audits and tech-debt lane findings.

patterns.title: Security officer
patterns.summary: Security lane: findings routed without stealing delivery throughput.

patterns.title: Workflow self-heal
patterns.summary: Repair signals from CI and config drift without colliding with intake.

patterns.title: Structured intake
patterns.summary: Idempotent intake: classify, structure, stage labels on Todo.

patterns.title: Requirement clarification
patterns.summary: Clarification pass when human or upstream left gaps.

patterns.title: BA specification
patterns.summary: BA spec depth, acceptance language, handoff readiness.

patterns.title: Developer execution
patterns.summary: Developer execution pattern aligned to pick windows.

patterns.title: PR self-review
patterns.summary: Self-review checklist before human review load.

patterns.title: CI failure recovery
patterns.summary: Recover from red checks without spamming the board.

patterns.title: Preview smoke check
patterns.summary: Verify preview is live and key flows work after deploy.

patterns.title: Preview failure triage
patterns.summary: When preview is flaky or red: narrow signal vs product defect vs infra.

patterns.title: Acceptance verification
patterns.summary: Verify acceptance criteria on In Review issues after preview passed.

patterns.title: Human handoff
patterns.summary: Clean escalation when automation must stop.

patterns.title: Retry sweep
patterns.summary: Bounded retry logic without hero agents.

patterns.title: Learning capture
patterns.summary: Capture what changed in policy or prompts after incidents.
